test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Indian religious festival has recently been included in the representative list of intangible cultural heritage of humanity by UNESCO, an organisation of the United Nations?
solution:
The correct answer is **Durga Puja.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• "Durga Puja in Kolkata" is now inscribed on the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
 
• India now has 15 intangible cultural heritage elements on the prestigious UNESCO Representative List of ICH of Humanity.
 
• In recent years, the ICH elements that saw inscriptions are Kumbh Mela (inscribed 2017), and Yoga (inscribed 2016) among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Janmashtami:**

 
• Janmashtami is celebrated by suspending a pot containing butter, curd, etc. high above the ground with people trying to break it by forming human pyramids.
 
• Krishna Janmashtami is celebrated on Bhadrapad Krishna Ashtami.
 
• It is the birth date of Lord Krishna.
 
• On this day, tableaux related to Shri Krishna's life are decorated in temples.
 
• 
 
After fasting for the whole day, after the birth of Shri Krishna at midnight, aarti and special pooja of Shri Krishna are performed and food is served.

 

**Recent Additions to India's UNESCO World Heritage Sites:**

 
• **Hoysala Temples of Karnataka: **UNESCO updated India's World Heritage Sites in September 2023, adding the 12th-century Hoysala Temples of Karnataka to the prestigious list.
 
• **Santiniketan in West Bengal: **It has also gained recognition as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in September 2023.
 
• Dholavira, an ancient Harappan City: On July 27, 2021,** **Dholavira, an ancient Harappan City in the Rann of Kutchh, was designated as India's 40th UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• Rudreswara Temple (Ramappa Temple): The** **Rudreswara Temple (Ramappa Temple) at Palampet, Warangal, Telangana, earned its place on the List of World Heritage Sites on July 25, 2021.
